en: Run the same query from a terminal:
zh: 在终端中运行相同的查询：

en: From an agent, call the MCP function:
zh: 在智能体中调用 MCP 函数：

en: The filter request failed. Change a filter to retry.
zh: 筛选请求失败，请调整筛选条件后重试。

en: One thing an agent did during a session: a file read or edit, a command, a search, an error, a decision. Hooks capture them automatically.
zh: 智能体在一次会话中做的一件事：文件读取或编辑、命令、搜索、错误、决策。钩子会自动捕获它们。

en: A durable fact the agent should keep across sessions, such as an architecture note, a convention or a preference. Saved with memory_save or distilled from observations.
zh: 智能体应跨会话保留的持久事实，例如架构说明、约定或偏好。用 memory_save 保存，或从观测中提炼而来。

en: A short rule learned from past work ("always run tsc before commit"). Its confidence grows when the agent re-confirms it and decays when unused.
zh: 从以往工作中总结出的一条简短规则（例如“提交前总是先运行 tsc”）。智能体再次确认时会提高其置信度，长期不用则会衰减。

en: A compact summary of one finished piece of work: what happened, tools used, files touched and lessons found. Kept after raw observations are pruned.
zh: 对一项已完成工作的精简总结：发生了什么、用了哪些工具、触及了哪些文件、发现了哪些经验教训。原始观测被裁剪后仍会保留。

en: A follow-up the agent tracked: a task, a decision to revisit, something blocked on input. Moves pending, active, done or blocked.
zh: 智能体跟踪的后续事项：一项任务、一个待重访的决策，或被输入阻塞的事项。状态在 pending、active、done、blocked 之间流转。

en: Actions that are unblocked and ready to pick up next. Everything they depend on is done.
zh: 未被阻塞、可随时接手下一步的行动。它们依赖的一切都已完成。

en: One run of an agent in a project, from start to end. Observations belong to a session.
zh: 智能体在项目中的一次运行，从开始到结束。观测隶属于某个会话。

en: Active means the agent is still running and sending observations. Completed means the session ended.
zh: Active 表示智能体仍在运行并持续发送观测；Completed 表示会话已结束。

en: The working directory an agent ran in. Memories, sessions and lessons are grouped by project.
zh: 智能体运行所在的工作目录。记忆、会话和经验教训按项目分组。

en: Which agent or role wrote a record (for example coder or reviewer). Used to keep multi-agent memories apart.
zh: 写下某条记录的智能体或角色（例如 coder 或 reviewer）。用于区分不同智能体的记忆。

en: A background step that turns many raw observations into fewer, longer-lived records: semantic facts and procedures. It needs an LLM provider.
zh: 一个后台步骤，将大量原始观测整合为更少但更持久的记录：语义事实和流程。需要配置 LLM 提供方。

en: General facts distilled from many sessions ("the API uses jose for JWT"). Produced by consolidation.
zh: 从多次会话中提炼出的通用事实（例如“the API uses jose for JWT”）。由整合产生。

en: Step-by-step workflows the agent repeated successfully ("to release: bump, tag, publish"). Produced by consolidation from finished sessions with a summary; it stays empty until enough such sessions exist.
zh: 智能体多次成功重复的逐步工作流（例如“to release: bump, tag, publish”）。由整合根据已结束且有总结的会话产生；在有足够多的此类会话之前保持为空。

en: Records that are never used lose strength or confidence over time, so stale knowledge stops crowding out fresh knowledge.
zh: 从未被使用的记录会随时间失去强度或置信度，这样过时的知识就不会挤占新知识。

en: How important a memory is, from 1 to 10. memory_save and the REST API store 7; consolidation rates each distilled memory itself. Stronger memories go first into the context agents get at session start, and bulk cleanup can target weak ones.
zh: 一条记忆的重要程度，1 到 10。memory_save 和 REST API 以 7 保存；整合会对每条提炼出的记忆自行打分。更强的记忆会优先进入智能体在会话开始时获得的上下文，批量清理也可以针对弱记忆。

en: A 1 to 10 score for how much an observation matters: 1 to 3 low (green), 4 to 6 medium (yellow), 7 to 10 high (red). With an LLM provider the compressor rates each observation; without one every observation gets the default 5. Session-start context uses observations rated 5 or higher, highest first, and old low-rated ones are evicted first.
zh: 一条观测的重要程度评分，1 到 10：1 到 3 为低（绿色），4 到 6 为中（黄色），7 到 10 为高（红色）。配置了 LLM 提供方时，压缩器会为每条观测打分；未配置时每条观测默认得 5。会话开始时的上下文使用评分 5 及以上的观测，按分数从高到低排列，旧的低分观测优先被淘汰。

en: How battle-tested a lesson is, from 0 to 100%. New lessons start at 50% unless the saver sets it. Each use closes 10% of the gap to 100% (50% becomes 55%). A lesson not used for a week loses 5 points per week, down to 5%; one that falls to 10% without ever being used is dropped. Recall ranks higher-confidence lessons first.
zh: 一条经验教训经过多少实战检验，0 到 100%。新经验教训默认从 50% 开始（保存者可自行设置）。每次使用会弥合与 100% 之间差距的 10%（50% 会变为 55%）。一周未使用的经验教训每周失去 5 分，最低到 5%；从未使用且跌到 10% 的会被丢弃。召回时置信度更高的排在前面。

en: How many times the lesson was confirmed again: saved again with the same text by any agent, or strengthened with memory_lesson_strengthen. Each use raises confidence and restarts the decay clock.
zh: 一条经验教训被再次确认的次数：任何智能体用相同文本再次保存，或用 memory_lesson_strengthen 加强。每次使用都会提高置信度并重置衰减计时。

en: The sessions, memories, observations or crystals a lesson was learned from. Crystal and import lessons record them automatically; pass sourceIds to POST /lessons to link a lesson you save by hand.
zh: 一条经验教训学自哪些会话、记忆、观测或结晶。结晶和导入的经验教训会自动记录来源；手动保存经验教训时可将 sourceIds 传给 POST /lessons 来关联。

en: The records the change touched. Memory, session, observation, lesson, action, crystal and graph ids open that record; other ids can be copied.
zh: 变更触及的记录。记忆、会话、观测、经验教训、行动、结晶和图谱的 id 可打开对应记录；其他 id 可复制。

en: Rules agentmemory infers from the files and concepts above: TypeScript when .ts files outnumber .js, a src/ layout when most files sit under src/, tests when test or spec files appear, and any concept that came up 3 or more times.
zh: agentmemory 从上述文件和概念中推断出的规则：.ts 文件多于 .js 时为 TypeScript，大多数文件在 src/ 下时为 src/ 布局，出现 test 或 spec 文件时为测试，以及出现 3 次及以上的任何概念。

en: Unblocked and ready to pick up next: every action it depends on is done. memory_frontier returns these first.
zh: 未被阻塞、可接手下一步：它依赖的每个行动都已完成。memory_frontier 会优先返回这些行动。

en: Saving a near-duplicate of a memory, or editing it here, creates a new version instead of changing it in place. v3 means two earlier versions exist. Only the latest version is searched; older ones stay as history.
zh: 保存一条记忆的近似副本，或在此编辑它，会创建一个新版本而非原地修改。v3 表示存在两个更早的版本。只有最新版本会被搜索，旧版本保留为历史。

en: Where a memory came from: the sessions and observations it was distilled from. Memories saved directly with memory_save or the REST API have none.
zh: 一条记忆的出处：它由哪些会话和观测提炼而来。用 memory_save 或 REST API 直接保存的记忆没有出处。

en: What changed from the previous version. Struck-through words were removed, highlighted words were added.
zh: 相比上一版本的变化。带删除线的词被删除，高亮的词是新增的。

en: The older memory this one replaced. The old version is kept for history but no longer returned by search.
zh: 被本条替代的旧记忆。旧版本保留为历史，但搜索不再返回它。

en: Where a record came from: an agent tool call, an automatic hook, an import or a user action.
zh: 一条记录的来源：智能体工具调用、自动钩子、导入或用户操作。

en: The full-text index used for keyword search. It holds observations, memories and lessons, so its document count is usually higher than the observation count.
zh: 用于关键词搜索的全文索引。它包含观测、记忆和经验教训，因此文档数通常高于观测数。

en: Embeddings used for meaning-based search. It needs an embedding provider; without one, search is keyword only.
zh: 用于按含义搜索的嵌入。需要配置嵌入提供方；未配置时搜索仅支持关键词。

en: Observations that are searchable. The keyword index also contains memories and lessons, which is why its total is larger.
zh: 可被搜索的观测。关键词索引还包含记忆和经验教训，因此总数更大。

en: Stored observations that are not searchable yet. They are added in the background; a large number that does not shrink means indexing is stuck.
zh: 已存储但尚不可搜索的观测。它们会在后台加入索引；如果数量很大且不减少，说明索引卡住了。

en: Every observation a hook sends is written here first and removed once it is stored. If storing fails or the server restarts, it is retried instead of lost. Dead letters are the ones that still failed after every retry.
zh: 钩子发送的每条观测都会先写到这里，存储成功后移除。如果存储失败或服务器重启，会重试而非丢失。死信是所有重试后仍失败的观测。

en: A small file on this machine where hooks keep observations when the server is down or does not answer. It is sent automatically on the next hook call and at every start, and each observation carries an event id so nothing is stored twice.
zh: 本机上的一个小文件：服务器宕机或无响应时，钩子将观测暂存在此。下次钩子调用和每次启动时会自动发送，每条观测都带有一个事件 id，因此不会重复存储。

en: Records waiting for an embedding so they can be found by meaning, not only by keywords.
zh: 等待生成嵌入的记录，以便能按含义而不仅是关键词被找到。

en: How many relations touch this node. Nodes with more relations are drawn larger and get their labels first.
zh: 与该节点相连的关系数量。关系越多的节点画得越大，也越先显示标签。

en: The observations that mentioned this entity, the sessions and projects they belong to, and memories distilled from the same observations or naming this entity. Imported code-graph nodes show the import instead.
zh: 提及该实体的观测、它们所属的会话和项目，以及由相同观测提炼或提及该实体的记忆。导入的代码图谱节点显示的是导入信息。

en: Nodes with no relation yet. They sit in the dashed box under the graph until an observation mentions them together with another entity.
zh: 尚无任何关系的节点。在某条观测同时提及它们和另一个实体之前，它们会待在图谱下方的虚线框中。

en: One entity in the knowledge graph, such as a file, a function, a library or a concept.
zh: 知识图谱中的一个实体，例如文件、函数、库或概念。

en: A relation between two entities, such as "uses", "fixes" or "depends on".
zh: 两个实体之间的关系，例如“uses”、“fixes”或“depends on”。

en: Protects against a failing LLM provider. Closed means calls go through normally. Open means too many recent failures, so calls are paused briefly. Half-open means it is testing whether the provider recovered.
zh: 保护 LLM 提供方免于故障蔓延。Closed 表示调用正常通过；Open 表示近期失败过多，调用短暂暂停；Half-open 表示正在测试提供方是否已恢复。

en: How many times agentmemory functions (observe, search, remember, summarize and so on) ran since the worker started, with their failure counts.
zh: 自工作进程启动以来，agentmemory 函数（observe、search、remember、summarize 等）运行了多少次，及各自的失败次数。

en: A rough estimate of prompt tokens saved by injecting a compact memory context instead of replaying every observation. It assumes about 80 tokens per observation and a 2,000 token budget per session.
zh: 通过注入精简的记忆上下文而非重放每条观测所节省的提示词 token 数的粗略估算。假设每条观测约 80 token，每个会话 2,000 token 预算。

en: JavaScript memory the worker is using, compared with the limit it may grow to. Warnings only matter when the process is also large overall.
zh: 工作进程正在使用的 JavaScript 内存，与其可增长上限的对比。只有当进程整体也很大时，警告才有意义。

en: Total memory the worker process holds from the operating system, including code and buffers.
zh: 工作进程从操作系统持有的总内存，包括代码和缓冲区。

en: How far behind the worker is in handling work. Under 20 ms is healthy; a large value means it is busy or blocked.
zh: 工作进程处理工作的滞后程度。低于 20 ms 为健康；数值很大说明它正忙或被阻塞。

en: How long the agentmemory worker has been running since it last started.
zh: agentmemory 工作进程自上次启动以来运行了多久。

en: Healthy means everything is normal. Degraded means something needs attention but memory still works. Critical means a core part is failing.
zh: Healthy 表示一切正常；Degraded 表示有事项需要注意，但记忆功能仍可用；Critical 表示核心部件正在故障。

en: Where the engine keeps every record: file (local files on this machine, the default) or redis (a Redis server set by AGENTMEMORY_STATE_BACKEND and AGENTMEMORY_REDIS_URL). ok means a test write and read just succeeded; the number is how long it took.
zh: 引擎保存所有记录的位置：file（本机的本地文件，默认）或 redis（由 AGENTMEMORY_STATE_BACKEND 和 AGENTMEMORY_REDIS_URL 指定的 Redis 服务器）。ok 表示一次测试写入和读取刚刚成功，数字是耗时。

en: Whether the agentmemory worker is connected to the iii engine that stores its data and runs its functions.
zh: agentmemory 工作进程是否已连接到存储数据并运行其函数的 iii 引擎。

en: The viewer keeps one streaming connection open and updates every page the moment data changes. Nothing is refreshed on a timer.
zh: 查看器保持一个流式连接，数据变化时立即更新所有页面。没有任何页面是按定时器刷新的。

en: Optional features that are on or off in this install. Off features leave some pages empty; each one lists the setting that turns it on.
zh: 本安装中可选功能的开/关。关闭的功能会让一些页面为空；每个功能都会列出开启它的设置。

en: A record of every change agentmemory made to stored data: saves, deletes, imports, consolidation runs. Use it to see who changed what and when.
zh: agentmemory 对存储数据所做的每次变更的记录：保存、删除、导入、整合运行。用它查看谁在何时改了什么。

en: Processes connected to the iii engine. agentmemory runs as one worker.
zh: 连接到 iii 引擎的进程。agentmemory 作为一个工作进程运行。

en: Average time one call of the function took to finish.
zh: 一次函数调用完成所用的平均时间。

en: Share of calls that failed. Functions that need an LLM show as off, not failing, when no LLM provider is set.
zh: 失败调用所占比例。未配置 LLM 提供方时，需要 LLM 的函数显示为关闭，而非失败。

en: Plays back a past session step by step: prompts, responses and tool calls in the order they happened, with their real timing. Works for any session agentmemory recorded, from any connected agent.
zh: 按步骤回放一次过去的会话：按实际发生顺序和真实时间展示提示词、响应和工具调用。适用于 agentmemory 记录的任何会话，来自任何已连接的智能体。

en: What agentmemory has learned about one project: the concepts and files that come up most and the conventions it noticed.
zh: agentmemory 学到的关于一个项目的信息：出现最频繁的概念和文件，以及它注意到的约定。

en: One square per day. The shade is how many observations the sessions that started that day recorded; darker means more. Only the sessions loaded in this viewer are counted, and the note under the grid says how many that is.
zh: 每天一个方格。颜色深浅表示当天开始的会话记录了多少条观测，越深越多。只统计本查看器已加载的会话，网格下方的说明会写明统计了多少个会话。

en: % of the heap limit in use (process memory
zh: % 的堆内存上限已被使用（进程内存

en: % of the heap limit in use, process memory
zh: % 的堆内存上限已被使用，进程内存

zh: 毫秒滞后。工作进程繁忙或被阻塞。
引擎连接已断开——正在重连。

zh: 纠正智能体时保存一条经验教训：

zh: 整合如何工作、计划与上次运行 →

zh: 将它们变为更持久的层：语义事实

zh: agentmemory 正在运行，等待第一个会话

en: . Every page fills in live, without a reload, as soon as an agent with agentmemory hooks runs.
zh: 。一旦有带 agentmemory 钩子的智能体运行，每个页面都会实时填充，无需刷新。

en: Wires hooks and the MCP server into Claude Code (or pick codex, cursor, gemini-cli and others from the list when you drop the name)
zh: 将钩子和 MCP 服务器接入 Claude Code（或在下拉列表中选择 codex、cursor、gemini-cli 等）

en: . This server is not on the default port 3111, so export its URL in the shell you start the agent from
zh: 。本服务器不在默认端口 3111 上，请在启动智能体的 shell 中导出它的 URL

en: Open your agent in a project and ask it anything. Sessions, observations and memories appear here as they are written.
zh: 在项目中打开你的智能体，随便问它点什么。会话、观测和记忆会在写入时显示在这里。

en: Each run of an agent in a project becomes a session with its own observations.
zh: 智能体在项目中的每次运行都会成为一个拥有自己观测的会话。

en: No agent with agentmemory hooks has started yet.
zh: 尚无带 agentmemory 钩子的智能体启动。

en: Start one by hand to see it appear here instantly:
zh: 手动启动一个，它会立即出现在这里：

en: No function has run since the worker started. Calls appear here as agents observe, search and save.
zh: 自工作进程启动以来尚无函数运行。当智能体进行观测、搜索和保存时，调用会显示在这里。

en: Everything agentmemory does appears here the moment it happens: new sessions, observations, saved memories, lessons and deletes.
zh: agentmemory 所做的一切都会在发生时立即显示在这里：新会话、观测、保存的记忆、经验教训和删除。

en: Nothing has changed since this page connected, and the audit log is empty.

en: A file the agent read, edited or that a code import found.
zh: 智能体读取或编辑过的文件，或代码导入发现的文件。

en: A function, class or other code symbol.
zh: 函数、类或其他代码符号。

en: A topic that came up in the work, such as pricing or auth.
zh: 工作中出现的话题，例如 pricing 或 auth。

en: An error or bug the agent ran into.
zh: 智能体遇到的错误或缺陷。

en: A decision or the reasoning behind one.
zh: 一项决策或其背后的理由。

en: A convention or approach that keeps coming back.
zh: 反复出现的约定或做法。

en: A person named in the work.
Something that happened at a point in time, such as a release.
zh: 在某个时间点发生的事，例如一次发布。

en: The two appeared in the same observation. Added without an LLM.
zh: 两者出现在同一条观测中。无需 LLM 即可添加。

en: One calls or uses the other.
zh: 一方调用或使用另一方。

en: One imports or loads the other.
zh: 一方导入或加载另一方。

en: One was caused by the other.
One needs the other to work.
zh: 一方需要另一方才能工作。

en: One is waiting on the other.
A person works at an organization.
A choice made to favor this goal.
zh: 为偏向该目标做出的选择。

en: An option that was considered and turned down.
zh: 一个被考虑过但否决的选项。

en: POST /agentmemory/graph/query failed. The server log has the HTTP error.
zh: POST /agentmemory/graph/query 失败。服务器日志中有 HTTP 错误。
